Subject: Request: Pen test fixes evidence for SOC 2 review

Hi Ben,

Following up on the pen test report you shared last week — our compliance team needs demonstrable evidence for a few of the critical and high findings before we close the ticket on our side. Specifically we need: 

- Screenshots/config screenshots showing the corrected IAM role policy and the removed broad s3:* access
- Ticket(s) showing the remediation work and closure notes (Jira preferred)
- Any compensating controls implemented (WAF rule IDs, temporary ACLs) where fixes were not possible immediately

We are trying to finalize the SOC 2 readiness checklist by May 1. Can you send a small evidence bundle or point us to a secure location with artifacts?

Thanks,
Liam
Security Lead, Finlytics

Hi Liam —

Thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 

1) I'll compile a focused evidence pack with screenshots and ticket links.
2) Mina will validate the technical artifacts and add notes on compensating controls where full remediation took longer.
3) We'll share a secure Drive link and a PDF index of artifacts by EOD Thursday (April 22).

Two quick clarifying Qs:
- For the IAM policy screenshot, do you want the console view or the JSON policy blob? We can provide both but want to prioritize what helps your auditors.

Looping in Mina for technical confirmation.

Hi Liam —

We validated the fixes yesterday (infra + app teams). Notes below and what we'll include in the packet: 

- IAM: Removed the overly permissive s3:* statement from role 'redwood-prod-deployer'. Attached: console screenshot (UI + JSON policy blob).
- Tickets: Jira INF-4321 (root cause, fix, review); INF-4322 (WAF tuning rule created). We'll export and redact user emails.
- Compensating controls: temporary WAF rule (ID: rw-waf-20270412) and a short-lived S3 bucket ACL restriction applied while we rolled out the policy change. We'll include rule config and timestamps.
- Validation: We re-ran the automated scanning used by our pen-test vendor; the specific CVE flagged in the report no longer reproduces on the staging stack as of 2027-04-20 02:30 UTC.

We will assemble: screenshots (console + JSON), redacted Jira export (PDF), a short remediation summary doc (pt-fix-summary-20270424.docx), and a CSV of timestamps for change windows.

For the IAM blob vs console view — we'll include both. For the WAF configs, we'll include the rule IDs and a sanitized config snippet in the evidence pack.

Mina Haddad
Security Engineering Manager
